context: Release workflow publishes an npm package when a new tag is pushed.
explanation: `permissions: write-all` grants the GITHUB_TOKEN every possible permission (packages, deployments, security events, etc.) when the job only needs enough to publish to npm. This violates the principle of least privilege — a compromised step can modify repo contents, create releases, or access other sensitive APIs. Fix: scope permissions to only what is needed, e.g. `contents: read` and `id-token: write`.
